nodes.label: Statistics T Noise Filter
nodes.rationale: 1st place (Team Kefir) innovation using std, var, rms, and pwr to filter low-quality audio.

nodes.label: Google Bird Classifier Pre-Labeler
nodes.rationale: Used by 1st place to filter data and generate pseudo-labels with a 0.05 coefficient.

nodes.label: CE Loss + Sigmoid Inference
nodes.rationale: 1st place strategy: train with CrossEntropy (multi-class) but infer with Sigmoid (multi-label) for stability.

nodes.label: Min() Ensemble
nodes.rationale: 1st place strategy to reduce uncertain predictions by taking the minimum probability across models.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Soup
nodes.rationale: 2nd place (ADSR) technique averaging multiple epoch weights to replace early stopping.

nodes.label: Multi-Iterative Noisy Student
nodes.rationale: 1st place (Nikita Babych) strategy using MixUp and power-transformed pseudo-labels.

nodes.label: PID Controller Matching
nodes.rationale: Core innovation for Google Brain Ventilator competition (1st, 2nd, 4th place) to reverse-engineer the physical control law.

nodes.label: Multi-Task Ventilator LSTM
nodes.rationale: Predicts both pressure and delta pressure (P[t] - P[t-1]) to improve regression accuracy.

nodes.label: ResNeSt + Attention Pooling
nodes.rationale: 1st place (Ryan Wong) architecture using Split-Attention and Attention Pooling instead of GAP.

nodes.label: Weak Supervision with PANNs
nodes.rationale: 1st place (DR) strategy using AudioSet pre-trained models and attention to locate calls without timestamps.

nodes.label: Multi-scale SED Model
nodes.rationale: 1st place (kdl) strategy combining 5s and 10s chunks with an AND rule to reduce false positives.

nodes.label: predict_with_tta
nodes.rationale: Implements Test Time Augmentation (TTA) by averaging predictions across multiple time shifts to improve stability.

nodes.label: and_rule_post_process
nodes.rationale: Combines short-window (5s) and long-window (10s) predictions using a logical AND to reduce false positives.

nodes.label: EnsembleModel
nodes.rationale: Generic ensemble wrapper for weighted averaging of multiple model predictions.
